candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care — continuity of care, interdisciplinary collaboration, client-centered care, quality and resource coordination, detailed content pp. 19-23.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — coordinated longitudinal primary care
candidate.educational_objective: Identify the five core functions of the patient-centered medical home: comprehensive, patient-centered, coordinated, accessible care with a focus on quality and safety.

options.A: Care is organized mainly around isolated acute visits with limited responsibility for coordination across clinicians, settings, or periods between appointments.
options.B: Care decisions are directed primarily by clinicians without incorporating patient preferences because standardization takes priority over individualized goals.
options.C: Care is comprehensive, patient-centered, coordinated, accessible, and focused on quality and safety within an ongoing primary care model.
options.D: Care is delivered only during inpatient admissions because the medical-home model is designed for hospital-based management rather than longitudinal primary care.

candidate.rationale: AHRQ defines the patient-centered medical home as a model for organizing primary care around five core functions: comprehensive care, patient-centered care, coordinated care, accessible services, and quality and safety. C includes all five defining attributes. A describes fragmented episodic care, B excludes the patient-centered partnership central to the model, and D incorrectly limits the model to inpatient care.
candidate.source_claim_supported: AHRQ defines the PCMH by five attributes: comprehensive care, patient-centered care, coordinated care, accessible services, and quality and safety, as a model for organizing primary care.
candidate.source_locator: Defining the PCMH — introductory definition and numbered sections 1-5: Comprehensive Care, Patient-Centered, Coordinated Care, Accessible Services, Quality and Safety.
candidate.source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)
candidate.stem: A primary care practice adopts a patient-centered medical home model. Which description best reflects this model?
